assessment: Many approaches to predict which animals species might be at risk of infection by SARS-CoV-2 focus on features of the ACE2 host cell receptor to which the virus binds. This important study shows that such methods are not uncovering a true biological signal. Instead, Mollentze and colleagues show that ACE2 sequences are effectively only a proxy for generic species relationships, and species phylogeny alone can provide equivalent predictive power.
